feed.title: NPR Topics: Science
feed.subtitle: The latest health and science news. Updates on medicine, healthy living, nutrition, drugs, diet, and advances in science and technology. Subscribe to the Health & Science podcast.

entry.title: Study finds 194-year-old tortoise is 'aging more slowly than you would expect'
entry.summary: Researchers are studying the genome of the world's oldest land animal — a 194-year-old tortoise named Jonathan — to uncover secrets about his longevity.

entry.title: 4 people on NASA's Crew-12 mission return to Earth after 8 months in space
entry.summary: Four people — two NASA astronauts, one from the European Space Agency and a Russian cosmonaut — spent nearly eight months at the space station, conducting spacewalks, science experiments and research.

entry.title: Medical debt is crushing hospital patients in LA. Health officials may have a fix
entry.summary: In Los Angeles County, the nation's most populous, a new system could screen hospital patients for financial aid, preventing hundreds of thousands from getting bills they can't pay.

entry.title: How 'Musk' director Alex Gibney became a critic
entry.summary: A trove of documents and interviews with people close to tech billionaire Elon Musk reveal a damning picture of his rise as one of the world's richest and most powerful men.

entry.title: This surprising mammal fossil is giving scientists something to chew on
entry.summary: It's likely you've already chewed and swallowed some tasty morsel today. But when did that ability emerge? New evidence points to at least the middle Jurassic, back when dinosaurs still reigned.

entry.title: Gut microbes followed migrating humans across continents, new study suggests
entry.summary: New research looks at the surprising similarities in the gut microbiomes of hunter-gathers in Tanzania and horticulturalists in Bolivia, and asks: What role do these bacteria play in human health?

entry.title: Scientists win chemistry Nobel for discoveries about mirrored molecules that led to many drugs
entry.summary: Scientists Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai won the Nobel Prize in chemistry for untangling mysterious mirror images in molecules, a discovery that has been used to develop countless drugs.

entry.title: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics has gone to a neutrino detector in Antarctica
entry.summary: The Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded Francis Halzen of the University of Wisconsin Madison, who built an observatory under Antarctica.

entry.title: Vietnamese police arrest 12 suspected of prowling city streets at night, snatching cats for meat
entry.summary: State media cited investigators who said the network recruited people to ride motorcycles through neighborhoods at night, trapping up to 10 cats a night.

entry.title: Francis Halzen wins Nobel Prize in physics for work on high-energy neutrinos from space
entry.summary: The 82-year-old scientist, originally from Belgium, is affiliated with the University of Wisconsin–Madison. His research into capturing neutrinos at the South Pole dates back to the 1980s.
